TAGLINE: Your Linux desktop, in real time.
INTRO: CORTEX NEO turns system information into independent neon desktop cards. Python collects shared telemetry; Lua and Conky draw historical graphs, optional hardware details and local diagnostic tools. Missing tools and sensors remain absent or unavailable rather than becoming invented readings.
RYZEN_ALT: CORTEX NEO running on the Ryzen 7 5700X and RTX 4060 Ti
DELL_ALT: CORTEX NEO running on the Dell Latitude 5420 and Intel Iris Xe
CAPTURE_NOTE: Both images are current captures of real installations. Values and versions reflect capture time; they are not hardcoded theme data. Lossless WebP preserves the original dimensions and every decoded pixel.
CAPTURE_DETAILS: Capture dates, display settings and provenance
CPU_TEXT: model, cores/threads, temperature, utilization history and top processes.
RAM_TEXT: usage, available memory, optional module/type/speed details and grouped application RSS.
GPU_TEXT: detected model, driver and available sensors; utilization/VRAM or frequency with their actual units.
STORAGE_TEXT: filesystem usage and mounted/unmounted devices, distinguishing drives with the same model.
NETWORK_TEXT: traffic history, separate Engine/Desktop counts and Compose groups.
VERSIONS_TEXT: installed applications and toolchains; empty categories disappear and long inventories paginate.
WEATHER_TEXT: seven-day forecast for a manually configured city and a monthly calendar highlighting today.
CADENCE_TEXT: Live metrics update every **2 seconds**. Mount changes refresh storage inventory; full disk scans run every 30 seconds. Versions and weather use longer cadences to keep the hot path light.
INSTALL_REQUIREMENTS: Requires **Linux with a graphical session, user systemd and Python 3.11+**. Automatic package profiles cover Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 and Debian 12/13.
INSTALL_BEHAVIOR: Run as your desktop user; only apt needs sudo. The installer prepares Conky, GTK, fonts and its own Python environment, enables user services and preserves personal settings. It does not install Docker, programming languages or GPU drivers.
PATH_NOTE: If the command is not yet on PATH, use `~/.local/bin/cortex-neo`.
FONT_FALLBACK: Missing families fall back safely; icons retain FontAwesome.
DETAIL_TEXT: `essential` hides secondary specifications and builds; `full` restores them. Primary models, versions, metrics, graphs and tops remain.
LAYOUT_TEXT: full/compact profiles, comfortable/complete density, landscape/portrait, opacity and card selection.
GALLERY_TEXT: Keep the overview focused on two real desktops; explore the other colors in the separate gallery.
GALLERY_LINK: See all ten palettes on a real desktop
CONFIG_TEXT: Edit simple JSON files under `~/.config/cortex-neo/` or use the CLI. Updates preserve your choices and manually configured city.
TOOL_DIAGNOSE: Check dependencies/session and identify installed source
TOOL_COST: Measure dashboard CPU/RSS and payload overhead
TOOL_MEMORY: Understand available RAM, swap, PSI and explicit PSS/USS
TOOL_DOCKER: Inspect engines, services and Compose projects
TOOL_INCIDENT: Keep a bounded before/after incident window
TOOL_CONTEXT: Review selected context for an agent
TOOL_SHARING: Hide personal labels and preview a support report
TOOLS_NOTE: These tools are local and opt-in. Observations retain freshness and accounting limits; they do not automatically infer causes or administer processes, containers or remote machines.
VALIDATION_TEXT: Validation combines Python 3.11–3.15, real Lua callbacks, native ARM64 logic, four clean distribution install/render jobs and two physical Ubuntu GNOME machines. Sensor support depends on kernel, driver and permissions; AMD coverage currently uses fixtures.
PRIVACY_TEXT: Weather requires a **manually configured city**. There is no GeoIP, GPS, GeoClue or Wi-Fi location detection. Open-Meteo receives the coordinates you configure and ordinary request network information; no network-anonymity claim is made.
DATA_TEXT: Personal settings, cache, screenshots and private records live outside source under XDG paths. Reports select fields for review and are never sent automatically.
UPDATE_TEXT: Run the same installer from a newly extracted ZIP or your updated checkout, then verify the result:
LIFECYCLE_TEXT: Immutable releases are prepared before switching; activation failure restores the previous runtime. `cortex-neo uninstall` removes owned installation controls while preserving personal data.
CONTRIBUTE_TEXT: Bug reports, checked compatibility reports and new translations are welcome.
MAINTENANCE_TEXT: Every README language is generated from one shared layout and matching translation keys. CI rejects manual drift; add a language by translating the same catalog.
NOTICES_TEXT: Retain copyright/license notices when reusing this work. External fonts, software, weather data and wallpapers retain their own rights.
